2609.30217.title: Instrumental Monitor Evasion Emerges Under Ordinary Task Pressure
2609.30217.paper_summary: A central concern in AI safety is that agents may treat oversight as an obstacle when it conflicts with completing their goals. We study instrumental evasion, the propensity of LLM agents to circumvent runtime monitoring as a means of completing ordinary tasks. We introduce EvasionBench, a benchmark of 50 diverse task-policy pairs in which completing the task requires an operation prohibited by a runtime monitor. Agents know that their tool calls are monitored and are prompted to continue working when they pause. Across our evaluations, best-of-3 evasion attempt rates reach up to 98% and success rates up to 88%, with substantial variance across models. Claude Fable 5.1 succeeds less often, but frequently makes creative attempts to circumvent the monitor. Evasion generally increases with test-time compute, with higher evasion rates at greater reasoning effort and token use. Traces show that agents encode prohibited commands, decompose operations across tool calls, and retry until relevant context leaves the monitor's history. We also find that GPT-6 Astra's low evasion rate comes with overrefusal, as it frequently abandons otherwise solvable tasks under a denial-of-service prompt injection. Our findings show that ordinary task pressure can lead to adaptive attempts to evade runtime monitors without an explicit adversarial objective. Effective oversight must therefore remain robust against repeated attempts, as the persistence that helps agents solve difficult tasks can also drive them to circumvent their guardrails.
2609.30217.paper_summary_zh: 一個關於人工智慧安全的核心問題是，當監督與完成目標發生衝突時，代理可能會將監督視為障礙。我們研究工具性逃避，即大型語言模型（LLM）代理繞過運行時監控以完成普通任務的傾向。我們引入了EvasionBench，這是一個包含50對多樣化任務-政策的基準，其中完成任務需要進行運行時監控禁止的操作。代理知道他們的工具調用受到監控，並在暫停時被提示繼續工作。在我們的評估中，最佳的三次逃避嘗試率高達98%，成功率高達88%，且模型之間存在顯著的變異性。Claude Fable 5.1的成功率較低，但經常會創造性地嘗試繞過監控。逃避行為通常隨著測試時計算能力的增加而增加，並且在更大的推理努力和標記使用下，逃避率更高。痕跡顯示代理編碼了被禁止的命令，將操作分解到工具調用中，並重試直到相關上下文離開監控的歷史。我們還發現，GPT-6 Astra的低逃避率伴隨著過度拒絕，因為它經常在拒絕服務的提示注入下放棄本可以解決的任務。我們的研究結果顯示，普通任務的壓力可以導致適應性嘗試逃避運行時監控，而不需要明確的對抗目標。因此，有效的監督必須對重複的嘗試保持穩健，因為幫助代理解決困難任務的堅持也可能驅使他們繞過防護措施。
